title: Food Delivery Service: Complete Architecture
description: Design food delivery service with monolith and microservice architectures using React, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and AWS.

data.text: Design a food delivery platform similar to DoorDash or Uber Eats that connects customers, restaurants, and delivery partners in real-time. Customers browse menus, place orders, and track deliveries live on a map. Restaurants receive orders, update preparation status, and manage menu availability. Delivery partners accept pickups, navigate optimized routes, and confirm deliveries with proof of completion.

data.title: Functional Requirements
items: Customer: Search restaurants by cuisine, rating, distance, delivery time, and price range
Customer: Browse restaurant menus with item descriptions, customization options, and dietary filters
Customer: Place orders with scheduled delivery windows, special instructions, and contactless delivery
Customer: Real-time order tracking on map with ETA updates, driver location, and status changes
Restaurant: Manage menu items, prices, availability, preparation time estimates, and operating hours
Restaurant: Receive new orders via printer/dashboard, accept/reject with reason, and update preparation status
Delivery Partner: View nearby available orders with earnings, distance, and restaurant name
Delivery Partner: Navigate with turn-by-turn directions, contact customer/restaurant via masked numbers
Payment: Process payments, apply promo codes and discounts, handle refunds, and support tipping
Rating: Collect star ratings and reviews for restaurants, delivery partners, and food quality

data.title: Non-Functional Requirements
items: Order placement confirms within 500ms with guaranteed idempotency for duplicate submissions
Order status updates propagate to customer and restaurant within 2 seconds
Delivery partner matching completes within 10 seconds of order placement
Real-time GPS tracking updates every 5 seconds with smooth interpolation on map
Support 1 million daily active users with 100,000 concurrent orders during peak dinner
99.9% payment success rate with automatic retry and idempotency for webhook duplicates

data.text: Start with a monolithic ASP.NET Core application that validates the food delivery domain: restaurant onboarding, menu management, order orchestration, delivery partner dispatch, payment processing, and notification delivery. This validates the core order lifecycle and state machine before splitting by domain.

terms.term: Frontend
- React 18 with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- React Query for server state
Backend (ASP.NET Core)
- Minimal API or MVC Controllers
- Entity Framework Core for data access
- Azure SQL Database or AWS RDS for relational data
- Built-in DI, logging, and health checks
Infrastructure
- Azure App Service or AWS EC2/ECS
- Azure Blob Storage or AWS S3 for file assets
- Azure Monitor or AWS CloudWatch for logging
- Single database with tables for all domains

data.text: As traffic grows, split the monolith into independently scalable microservices. Each service owns its data and communicates via async messaging or REST/gRPC.

items: Restaurant Service: Manages restaurant profiles, onboarding, operating hours, preparation time estimates, and capacity limits. Enforces geo-indexed queries for discovering restaurants by delivery address using spatial search.
Menu Service: Handles menu item CRUD with support for variants (size, spice level), add-ons (extra cheese, sauces), dietary badges (vegan, gluten-free), and dynamic pricing with time-based discounts.

Order Service: Orchestrates the complete order lifecycle from cart to delivery confirmation. Implements the order state machine (created, restaurant accepted, preparing, ready, picked up, delivered) with saga pattern for distributed transactions across payment, restaurant, and delivery services.

Delivery Partner Service: Manages driver onboarding, vehicle verification, availability status, and earnings. Implements dispatch matching with ETA-aware assignment that balances customer wait time with driver pickup distance.

Payment Service: Processes payments with retry logic, applies promo codes and loyalty points, handles refunds and tips, and reconciles daily settlement reports for restaurants and drivers. Uses idempotency keys to prevent double-charge on network retry.

Notification Service: Sends order status updates via SMS, push notification, and in-app alerts to customers, restaurants, and drivers. Manages notification preferences per user and deduplicates alerts across channels.

Tracking Service: Ingests GPS pings from delivery partner apps, smooths trajectories using Kalman filtering, computes ETAs using historical traffic data, and publishes real-time location updates to customer and restaurant maps via WebSocket.

restaurants.ts        # GET /restaurants/nearby, GET /restaurants/
tracking.ts           # GET /orders/

cartStore.ts          # Items, quantities, selected variants, promo code
orderStore.ts         # Active orders, status, driver info, ETA
Key Patterns
- Feature-based folder structure
- API Gateway as single entry point
- React Query for menu caching with background refetch on restaurant open/close
- Mapbox or Google Maps JS SDK for live tracking and route rendering
- Service Worker for offline cart persistence and cached restaurant browsing
